mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, account_id, order_type, status, product_code, price_version_code, product_snapshot, currency, original_amount_minor, discount_amount_minor, payable_amount_minor, paid_amount_minor, client_request_id, expires_at, paid_at, fulfilled_at, closed_at, created_at, updated_at

o.order_no, o.status, o.order_type, o.product_code, o.price_version_code, o.product_snapshot, o.currency, o.payable_amount_minor, o.paid_amount_minor, o.expires_at, o.paid_at, o.fulfilled_at, o.created_at, p.payment_no, p.status AS payment_status, p.provider AS payment_provider, r.status AS refund_status, r.succeeded_at AS refund_succeeded_at

LEFT JOIN payment_attempt p ON p.id = ( SELECT latest_payment.id FROM payment_attempt latest_payment WHERE latest_payment.order_id = o.id ORDER BY latest_payment.created_at DESC, latest_payment.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.id = ( SELECT latest_refund.id FROM refund_order latest_refund WHERE latest_refund.order_id = o.id ORDER BY latest_refund.created_at DESC, latest_refund.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE billing_order SET status = 'PAID', paid_amount_minor = payable_amount_minor, paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, #{paidAt}), updated_at = #{paidAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CLOSED', 'PAID')
mapper.select: SELECT order_no FROM billing_order WHERE status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING_PAYMENT') AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM commercial_account WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.order_no, o.product_snapshot, o.fulfilled_at, MAX(g.valid_from) AS valid_from, MAX(g.expires_at) AS expires_at FROM billing_order o JOIN entitlement_grant g ON g.source_type = 'ORDER' AND g.source_id = o.order_no WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN ('FULFILLED', 'REFUNDING') AND g.status = 'ACTIVE' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(o.product_snapshot, '$.productType')) = 'PLAN' AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, o.product_snapshot, o.fulfilled_at ORDER BY expires_at DESC, o.fulfilled_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.*, p.product_code, p.product_type, p.display_name, p.description FROM billing_price_version v JOIN billing_product p ON p.id = v.product_id WHERE v.version_code = #{versionCode} AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (v.sell_from IS NULL OR v.sell_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND (v.sell_until IS NULL OR v.sell_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM billing_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.*, o.order_no, o.status AS order_status, o.user_id, o.account_id FROM payment_attempt p JOIN billing_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_no = #{paymentNo}
FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM payment_attempt WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
